Class ZModElement<M extends Modulus>

java.lang.Object
AbstractMath.Rings.ZMod.ZModElement<M>
All Implemented Interfaces:
RingElement<ZModElement<M>>
public class ZModElement<M extends Modulus> extends Object implements RingElement<ZModElement<M>>
Represents an element of the ring of integers modulo a fixed positive modulus. A ring is a mathematical object consisting of a set and two operations, addition and multiplication, whose results remain in that set. Addition is associative and commutative, multiplication is associative, and multiplication distributes over addition. Integers wrapped in modular arithmetic with the same modulus form a ring. This class provides the operations through add(ZModElement) and multiply(ZModElement). The additive identity is returned by zero(), and the multiplicative identity is returned by one(). Adding zero or multiplying by one leaves an element unchanged. Every element has an additive inverse, returned by negate().
